context.description: Optional metadata attached to this entity when it was added to the list. Contains arbitrary key-value pairs set by the caller via the Add Entity endpoint. Only present if context was provided when the entity was added.

id.description: Tag entity ID in the format `enum:EntityListTag:<tagname>`

name.description: Tag name as used in API requests (e.g., `tier1`, `critical`)

tags.description: Tags associated with this entity in the list. Empty array if no tags are assigned.

added.description: Timestamp when the entity was added to the list

ProcessingStatus.description: `pending` — awaiting initial processing after being added; `processing` — currently being indexed; `ready` — fully processed and available for use in alerts and queries.
